notes.title: Quick Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with the skeleton coffin, Skeletons will now spawn in front of the coffin, and the coffin can be killed by touching it

- Fixed a bug with the Lich's hands. They should not shoot lightening correctly.

notes.title: Endless Mode Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added an Endless Mode after the True Ending is unlocked!
[*]The coin amount above the players head now shows the amount of coins you get with the current combo multiplier. This makes the number above your head accurate to what you are actually getting as currency to spend in the store
[*]Bosses no longer coins on death, instead the amount just goes right into your total coins and appears above the players head. This helps fix frame drops due to too many coin objects moving at once, and it fixes the issue that could cause you not to collect coins if the boss died outside of the maze.
[*]There is now a little red meter next to your combo that lets you know how long you have until the combo goes away
[*]When getting an equipment upgrade, it will no longer select gear that is at max level, and will only upgrade items that can use upgrades.
[*]Bosses can no longer spawn on left and right maze chunks. The game will wait until you make it to a corner chunk, and then the boss will spawn.
[*]Fixed: Getting stuck in Slow Mo
[*]Fixed: Audio glitch with Bush Monster and Enemy Death Noise
[*]Fixed: Boss meter being full but boss never spawns
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Save Reset to Prepare for Full Release
notes.notes:

notes.title: Final Demo Content Update before Release
notes.notes:
Quack Quack,
Bad news first. to prepare for the full release of the game, this update had to reset demo progress. 

The demo has been updated with lots of features and bug updates to prepare for the full game. 
Release date announcement coming soon! 

New features! 

[list]
    [*]New Traps
    [*]New Enemies
    [*]Each level has several different color palettes
    [*]Rebalancing of the store and enemy spawns
[/list] 

Im so excited for the full games release. Thank you for all of the support!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Quack Quack! [/h1]

[h2]Lots of exciting new updates to the Dungeons and Ducklings demo[/h2]

[list]
[*] Full original soundtrack has been added
[*] Adorable intro cutscene
[*] Fully voice acted dialogue
[*] New enemies, including the Minotaur!
[*] Brand new traps
[*] Brand new hats and better hat art
[*] Zone 2 has been added after the first boss
[*] Settings menu allows volume adjustments.
[*] UI updates
[/list]


It has been really exciting adding all of these new features to the game. More bosses, enemies, traps, player gear, and more is in the works. 
I can't wait show off some of the Library that contains an adorable Panda Bear Librarian. Panda helps you learn about enemies, and the lore of the world. 

Thank you all for playing the demo. I could use your help to spread the word about this indie game.
